items.title: Why Is Salesforce (CRM) Deploying IL5 AI Agents In A Major Government Role?
items.summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has deployed IL5-authorized Agentforce 360 AI agents to the U.S. Army Human Resources Command under Missionforce National Security. The rollout introduces autonomous, always-on AI support for millions of Soldiers, Veterans, and families across routine HR processes. The deployment is described as the first use of IL5-authorized AI agents within the Department of War for mission-critical human resources workloads.
